model: 3S 850 mAh pack of the Pavo20 Pro II

sources.description: The stakeholder's note of 2026-11-08 about the BetaFPV Pavo20 Pro II (sources/stakeholder-pavo.txt; data/flight-logs/inventory.json): a 3S 850 mAh battery; not a datasheet.

The aircraft's own parameters in stakeholder-pavo-log_34_UnknownDate.bin: MOT_BAT_VOLT_MAX 13.05 V and MOT_BAT_VOLT_MIN 9.9 V over three cells (4.35 V and 3.3 V per cell); the owner's settings, not a cell datasheet. The same log's BATT_CAPACITY is 720 mAh.

ArduPilot's own in-flight estimate of the pack resistance in stakeholder-pavo-log_34_UnknownDate.bin: the median of BAT.Res over the log, 0.0771 ohm (0.0721 ohm at its end); an estimate from voltage and current, not a bench measurement.

applicability: Three cells and 0.85 Ah as the stakeholder states them (the logs set BATT_CAPACITY 720 mAh); cell voltages from the owner's MOT_BAT_VOLT_* settings, which suit a high-voltage pack; chemistry not known.
